title: Sheffield United vs. Wrexham: Preview, Predictions and Lineups
subtitle: SI
paragraphs: By Rich FayOct 29, 2026Sheffield United and Wrexham both know a win this weekend could kickstart their season. / Morgan Harlow/WSL Football/Getty Images (Sheffield United), Robbie Jay Barratt/AMA/Getty Images (Wrexham)Wrexham will hope to kickstart their season when they travel to face old foes Sheffield United in the Championship on Friday.

The Red Dragons have won just three of their first 12 league matches this season, with only one victory in their four games since the October international break. The Blades have fared only marginally better, with four wins from their opening 12 league matches. The hosts will also believe a victory this weekend could spark an eventual climb up the table.
Wrexham won both meetings with Sheffield United last season and should be prepared for a hostile reception against the team they faced in an epic FA Cup encounter as a National League club.

Wrexham have won only three matches this season. / Wrexham AFCWrexham and Sheffield United find themselves in similar positions heading into the weekend clash, with two experienced teams overseen by veteran managers. Phil Parkinson got the better of Chris Wilder twice last season, but there is sure to be no love lost between the pair, who were apprentices together as teenagers at Southampton.

The Red Dragons are six points off the playoff positions and six points clear of the relegation zone, meaning a single result could significantly influence the mood around the club. With just three matches remaining before the next international break, this already feels like a game Wrexham cannot afford to lose.

Chris Wilder could be without Patrick Bamford from the start against Wrexham. / FotMobWilder could make changes to his starting lineup as Sheffield United target a victory over Wrexham. The Blades could retain an unchanged backline, with Hamza Choudhury operating at right back, while Kalvin Phillips is expected to start in central midfield alongside Ollie Arblaster.

Patrick Bamford is a doubt after being forced off with an injury in the recent draw with Derby County, potentially opening the door for Jordan Ayew to come into the starting lineup. Tahith Chong and Ben Brereton Díaz are likely to retain their places out wide.
Sheffield United predicted lineup vs. Wrexham (4-2-3-1): Cooper; Choudhury, Tanganga, Kitching, Burrows; Phillips, Arblaster; Chong, Cannon, Brereton Díaz; Ayew.

Phil Parkinson could make two changes to his starting lineup. / FotMobParkinson could also freshen up his side as Wrexham look to return to winning ways this weekend. Even if Cleworth is available, the manager could stick with the same defensive lineup, with Joe Worrall likely to retain his place at the heart of the back three. Danny Imray could replace Issa Kaboré at right wing back.
Ben Sheaf should start alongside Matty James if fit, with Callum O’Hare operating in the attacking midfield role. Kieffer Moore is expected to continue up front alongside Sam Smith.
Wrexham predicted lineup vs. Sheffield United (3-4-1-2): Patterson; Hyam, Worrall, Doyle; Imray, James, Sheaf, Ekomié; O’Hare; Smith, Moore.
